step_4.reason: All 5 natural and all 5 same-parameter-ceiling test projections are negative at the predeclared 10000-query forecast; all proposals retain fixed_4.

step_6.reason: All 400 recorded tasks are correct, but learned expert work ties fixed capability on known combinations and is greater on novel combinations; routing/training overhead is additional. The fourth old-domain/known-combination test population is absent.

limitations: No-replay recent accuracy is persisted raw training accuracy, not separately recorded thresholded future-serving accuracy.
Replay and no-replay have identical catalog/initial parameters and optimizer steps, but replay processes four times as many examples.
Calibration has 3 previously trained positive addresses per seed and selected threshold zero; 15 zero-error examples do not establish population calibration.
Clean-refit tensor equality/source exclusion is verified; historical source and artifact copies persist, and statistical unlearning is not proved.
Structure values are frozen-price scenario projections, not measured money/energy; the strongest fixed baseline optimistically waives its model-selection search cost.

Same-parameter comparison means the same byte ceiling with integer-width slack, not exactly equal counts. Its recorded test cost is available, but raw winner/baseline test predictions were not separately saved.

Transfer specialists and capability ranges are predefined. New-domain values are written and experts rebuilt before reads; the learned allocation, not new memory facts, transfers without router refitting.
Transfer has three test populations; old-domain known combinations are selection-only. No missing test population was reconstructed by inference.
Recorded transfer expert work excludes routing; learned routing adds 44 dot-product work units per query. Capability routing work has no equivalent proxy, although its wall time is recorded.
All strategies execute in a fixed order with shared filesystem caches; recorded timings are descriptive and not a controlled latency superiority test.

Transfer model training/artifact costs are shared across strategies. Fixed capability needs the same specialist inventory but no learned router or selection feedback; a general-only deployment needs fewer experts.
Learning composition expected values share the registered interpreter; this analysis checks stored outcomes and lineage without recomputing new gold or executing any model.
